description: A complete line graph comparing average milk protein percentage and average milk fat percentage across the full lactation period, with both labelled series, axes, scale, and legend visible.
The complete Grass Growth Curve and Feed Demand graph from February to November, showing the blue yield-of-dry-matter line, red dashed feed-demand line, both axes, legend, and source attribution.
A complete diagram of the California Mastitis Test apparatus and result plate, including the labelled wells and visible reaction patterns needed to interpret the test.
The complete goat performance table used in Question 7, with the animal records, column headings, figures, units, and all rows visible for reading and comparison.
The complete Ewe Mothering Ability scale from 1 to 5, its behaviour descriptions, ewe-and-lamb photograph, and the full results table for ewes 106, 107, and 108.
A complete agricultural growth graph with its plotted curve, labelled axes, numeric scale, and all annotations required to read the value requested in Question 15(c)(i).
Four complete plant photographs labelled A, B, C, and D, presented in their original examination layout for plant identification.
The complete Integrated Pest Management stimulus, including the crop imagery and every printed element needed to distinguish the control approaches asked about in Question 18(c).
Two complete parent-animal photographs labelled A and B, shown side by side in the original breeding-question layout with both identifying letters visible.
Six complete lambing and livestock-care equipment photographs labelled A through F, arranged in the original two-row examination table.
Four complete plant photographs labelled A to D with the printed word bank Chicory, White clover, Perennial ryegrass, and Nettle visible above them.
The complete Causes of Lamb Mortality bar chart, with all five cause categories, percentage-mortality scale, plotted values, axis labels, title, and source attribution visible.
The complete Lamb Growth Rate and Weight graph, showing single and twin lamb series from birth to 25 weeks, every plotted value, axes, units, and legend.
Three complete crop photographs labelled J, K, and L with the printed word bank Maize, Oilseed rape, and Wheat visible above the images.
Four complete calf-feeding photographs labelled A to D: calves on milk replacer, a calf on hay, a calf on grass, and a calf being fed colostrum.
A complete interior photograph of a modern cattle house, showing roof structure and skylights, open penned bays, slatted flooring, feed barriers, bedding, and housed cattle.
The complete dry-matter percentage tick-box table for Tom's silage, showing the three answer options 25%, 45%, and 65% with their empty selection boxes.
The complete Seven year growth of Irish Dairy Exports grouped bar chart, comparing 2015 and 2021 tonnages for five products with axes, legend, scale, and source attribution.
